messages.author: ecb7e78da7cf0bfd
messages.subject: Map with ggplot2
parts:
I would like to make a map with ggplot2 in which I want to plot share of four categories, say A, B, C and D. I would like to split each polygon into these four categories, dividing the area of the polygon in the same proportion as the shares of A, B, C and D, and fill each segment with a colour corresponding to the category.

Any idea if this can be done, and how?

Vikas Rawal

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Map with ggplot2
parts:
Can you supply at least a reproducible dataset and what you've tried so far?

ggmap might be able to do this, but I've not seen anything like this.
Additionally, I'm not sure how useful this would be on polygons that
touch each other. Would quickly end up with a cluster of colors that
just look like a mess.

If you don't mind using subplots, how about scatterpie?

https://stackoverflow.com/questions/10368180/plotting-pie-graphs-on-map-in-ggplot

HTH, B
